parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.

parameters.name: InstanceClass
parameters.description:
The instance specifications after the upgrade. You can call [DescribeDtsJobDetail](~~208925~~) to query the instance specifications before the upgrade.

- Specifications supported by data migration instances: **xxlarge**, **xlarge**, **large**, **medium**, and **small**.
- Specifications supported by data synchronization instances: **large**, **medium**, **small**, and **micro**.

> For more information about the description and performance test results of each specification, see [Specifications of data migration instances](~~26606~~) and [Specifications of data synchronization instances](~~26605~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).
